policy.canonical_taxonomy_authority: LUMI defect ontology, not evaluator majority vote
policy.taxonomy_adjudication_rule: When two independent validators both confirm a blocking defect on the injected gold span but disagree on family naming, the canonical mutation definition may assign the family label; one-validator-only cases remain quarantined.

rejection_reason: Response supplement v1 introduced additional blocking/dangling-thread semantics on the injected span. Dual validators often confirmed a blocking problem but disagreed on family because the mutation was not a clean single-defect example. Canonical relabeling cannot replace the independent-validation requirement for a controlled single-defect benchmark.
